title.zh: 阶跃3999元智能体手机发布：一句话造App，还能接入支付宝收款
title.en: 阶跃3999元智能体手机发布：一句话造App，还能接入支付宝收款

current_state.zh: StepFun's STEPX brand unveiled the STEPX Neo agent phone — a 3,999 RMB Android 16-based device running the Amoo personal agent with Alipay/WeChat/Ctrip/Didi integrations and a Step Studio toolchain for building and monetizing AI apps via natural language — going on sale October 16.
